tagline: Attach Drive documents to Asana tasks and organize deliverables automatically
metaTitle: Asana + Google Drive Integration: Project Folders in Drive
metaDescription: Create Drive folders for new Asana projects and attach files to tasks. GAIA alerts assignees when deliverables change. See the setup steps.
intro:
Project tasks in Asana rarely exist in isolation — they reference briefs, specs, reports, and deliverables stored in Google Drive. Without automation, team members spend time hunting through folders for the right document, or they attach stale file versions to tasks because the link was shared months ago and the file has since moved.

GAIA connects the two so documents are always where you expect them. When a new project launches, GAIA creates a corresponding folder with the right structure. As tasks progress, GAIA attaches the relevant documents automatically. When a deliverable is updated in the folder, GAIA notifies the task assignee so reviews happen promptly.

This integration is essential for content teams, marketing agencies, and operations departments that rely on Google Drive as their document store and Asana as their project management layer.

useCases.title: Create Drive project folders from Asana projects
useCases.description: When a new project is created in Asana, GAIA automatically creates a structured folder in Google Drive with subfolders for briefs, deliverables, and references, and attaches the folder link to the project.

useCases.title: Auto-attach Drive files to Asana tasks
useCases.description: When a file is added to a project folder, GAIA attaches it to the corresponding task based on naming conventions or folder structure, eliminating manual link sharing.

useCases.title: Notify assignees when deliverables are updated
useCases.description: When a document linked to a task is edited, GAIA posts a comment on the task notifying the assignee that the file has been updated, prompting timely review.

useCases.title: Archive completed project documents
useCases.description: When a project is marked complete, GAIA moves the associated files to an archive folder and records the final document links in the project description for future reference.

useCases.title: Generate task briefs from document templates
useCases.description: When a task is created for a recurring deliverable type, GAIA creates a document from the appropriate template, pre-fills it with task metadata, and attaches it to the task automatically.

howItWorks.step: Authorize Asana and Google Drive in GAIA
howItWorks.description: Connect your Asana workspace and Google Drive account to GAIA. Specify the root folder where project folders should be created and the projects to monitor.

howItWorks.step: Configure folder structure and attachment rules
howItWorks.description: Define the folder template for new projects and the rules GAIA uses to match files to tasks, by file name pattern, subfolder, or task custom field.
GAIA monitors projects and folders for changes, creating folders, attaching files, and posting notifications so your team always finds the right document attached to the right task.

faqs.question: Can GAIA attach a specific Drive file to an Asana task on demand?
faqs.answer: Yes. Ask GAIA to find a specific file by name and attach it to a task. GAIA searches the folders, retrieves the file, and adds the attachment to the task.

faqs.question: Does GAIA create one folder per project or per task?
faqs.answer: By default, GAIA creates one folder per project with subfolders for major task groups. You can also configure per-task document creation for high-volume or template-driven workflows.

faqs.question: What happens to the files if a project is deleted?
faqs.answer: GAIA does not delete files when a project is removed. It can optionally move the files to an archive folder and log the action so documents are preserved for compliance or reference purposes.
